> OpsDoctor Investigation
> Incident: INC-2026-042 | Flow: checkout-v2

proposed_payload.comment_text:
OpsDoctor Investigation
Incident: INC-2026-042
Flow: checkout-v2
Status: Escalated by Operator

Findings:
- PayPal: Repeated capture failures observed on checkout-v2 with HTTP 422 ORDER NOT APPROVED
- Slack: Deployment checkout-api-2026.09.25.3 preceded the alert spike
- Gmail: Enterprise customer complaints logged in support queue

Policy:
- Payment Procedures requires Finance escalation when more than 5 failed transactions occur within 15 minutes

Assessment:
- Threshold satisfied. Formal escalation staged per operator confirmation

Recommended next steps:
1. Finance review by @daniel.kim
2. Engineering deployment inspection by @ethan.cole

Generated by OpsDoctor
